To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
bestrophin- 1 binds to the β-subunit of voltage dependent Ca2+ channels and that this interaction is mediated by a novel proline-rich motif on the bestrophins C-terminus.
bestrophin- 1 modulates the surface expression and function of L-type Ca2+-channels via binding to β-subunits.
we identified a new highly proline-rich region on the C-terminus of bestrophin 1 that enables binding to the β-subunits.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the interaction of bestrophin 1 and Ca2+-channels.
the interaction of bestrophin 1 with β-subunits of voltage-dependent L-type calcium channels.
the interaction between bestrophin- 1, β-subunits of voltage dependent Ca2+ channels and pore forming subunits of L-type Ca2+-channels.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proline-rich motifs in the bestrophin C-terminus are important to maintain the interaction with β-subunits and to modulate the function of CaV channels.
bestrophin- 1 is able to bind to CaV β-subunits, and that this interaction is important for CaV channel function and membrane localization.
bestrophin- 1 and β-subunits interact via the C-terminus of bestrophin 1.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the β-subunits and the C-terminus of bestrophin are important for the regulation of the number of CaV1 channels in the cell membrane.

bestrophin- 1 and β-subunits of voltage-dependent L-type calcium channels interact with each other and that this interaction is important to maintain the function of β-subunit in the regulation of Ca2+ channel proteins.
bestrophin- 1 modulates β-subunit functions by binding to β-subunits, and that the β-subunit functions are regulated by the C-terminal region of bestrophin 1.
The main takeaway from our work is that
bestrophin- 1 modulates Ca2+ channels function by binding to β-subunits and by influencing the β-subunit function.
bestrophin- 1 modulates CaV1.2 Ca2+ channel function through its C-terminus by interacting with β-subunits.
bestrophin- 1 and β-subunits are important regulators of each others’ function.
